nom: ANUA 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some describing it as damaged, flaky, or 'exceptionally dry,' consistently report strong, lasting hydration and less tightness or parched feeling, though a few still layer a separate moisturizer on top for full relief in winter.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including some managing reactive or acne-prone skin, report no irritation, calmer redness, and a strengthened barrier; one reviewer with sensitive skin cautions that it stings noticeably if applied over broken or open skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including those who lean dry or oily in different areas, report the serum balances both zones and hydrates without clogging pores or causing breakouts.
segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or acne-prone skin report the serum feels light enough not to add excess oil or greasiness, and several credit it with calming redness and irritation caused by other treatments like benzoyl peroxide or chemical exfoliants.
segments.normal: The two reviewers who describe their skin as normal (one also partly dry) report mixed results: one found the serum kept her skin balanced and glowy, while the other found the hydration underwhelming and noticed extra breakouts.

concerns.aging: A few reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines and a firmer, more youthful look after consistent use, though these effects are described as subtle rather than dramatic.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, including those with dry, dehydrated, or damaged-barrier skin, report deep, long-lasting hydration and softer, plumper skin, often citing it as a favorite for winter dryness; however, a few reviewers found the hydration underwhelming or short-lived and felt they still needed a separate moisturizer to feel fully hydrated.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers, including some using it to calm irritation from benzoyl peroxide or over-exfoliation, report the serum visibly reduces redness within days; however, one reviewer whose skin was already reactive from a cleanser reports the serum made the irritation worse, causing hive-like breakouts.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describing a damaged, compromised, or 'broken' skin barrier report the serum visibly strengthens and repairs it within days to weeks, with several specifically praising the ceramide content for this.
concerns.spots: Reviewers dealing with hyperpigmentation, acne scars, or uneven tone, including a woman of color who struggled with dark spots after a climate change, report gradual fading and a more even complexion with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report the serum does not trigger breakouts and in some cases calms existing acne, but several reviewers report new blemishes after starting it — including hive-like breakouts, small whiteheads, extra breakouts over two weeks, and small pustules that one reviewer links to a niacinamide sensitivity.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the serum helps balance sebum and oil production, thanks to its niacinamide and zinc content, without feeling greasy or heavy.

extraits.texte: Not only have the oil cleanser completely ruined my skin after judt 2 uses (i never broke out b4 btw) i tried this hoping it would calm the burning and itchiness from thr break out the cleanser caused but no this made it worse unfortunately i broke out even more this time it looks like hives

This serum is one of the two products I've tried by Anua recently. I've also tried thrir rice enzyme cleansing powder. I have dry to normal skin type with a hormone imbalance for some background information. This serum has a texture that's similar to snail muscin and bean essence serums. It does not remain sticky though. I find that this serum isn't as hydrating as I hoped it would be. It doesn't take much to use though for the immediate hydrating effect, it just doesn't last for me sadly. I've also noticed some extra breakouts lately too and I can only conclude that they are from using this serum. I say give it a shot though because everyone's skin biome is different so it may work for you unlike it did for me. You never know until you try.

I have very dry skin, and my skin barrier is definitely damaged, so I was looking forward to using this serum. What I really liked about this product was that it absorbed very quickly into my skin. I really appreciated how it didn't leave my face feeling sticky like a lot of other products do. I do think this product is soothing, it calmed down the redness of my face. Even though this serum is somewhat hydrating, I still needed to use a moisturizer afterwards in order to truly heal my skin. Thus, I think something that could be improved about this product is to make it more moisturizing so that people only need to use this serum in their routine and can minimize the amount of other products they need to use. Overall, I am excited to keep using this product and see what benefits it continues to bring to my skin.

extraits.titre: Best Barrier Serum for Skin of Color
extraits.texte: I have darker, oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin, and this is the best barrier serum I've ever used. Like, it does all the things I like and need: repairs skin barrier with the ceramides, helps with hyperpigmentation and acne scars with the alpha arbutin, evens skin tone with the niacinamide, moisturizes without being thick or occlusive with the glycerin and beta-glucan and rice water derivatives. This is by far my favorite ceramide serum. I've used the Cocokind barrier serum too, and it was the same cost for a little over half the amount of product as the Anua serum. And the Anua serum lasts three times as long as the Cocokind serum does, since the slimy texture makes just one pump cover more area. My bottle of the Anua serum lasted me about 3 months, and my skin DRASTICALLY improved over that time. My acne scars were much less visible, my skin was smooth and more even toned. My only complaint is that the Anua serum really stings if applied over broken or open skin, maybe because of the alpha arbutin or niacinamide, so be aware of that when trying it for the first time. Otherwise, I really love it!!! It does everything I want and feels like a snail mucin serum without the animal cruelty or fungal acne issues. Do try it out!!!

extraits.titre: Life changing serum for my dry acne prone skin
extraits.texte: I've been really struggling with dry skin and acne since moving to the desert from a humid climate. I didn't know what to do with my skin because I kept getting dark spots and I'm a woman of color. This serum has definitely changed my skin. I've noticed my dark spot feeding and I even did one round of micro needling to help jumpstart the results and I always get compliments on my skin now about how I have such a glow. I will continue to purchase this serum for as long as it works for me!

This product was recommended to me by my cousin. We both have different skin types. I have oily skin and deal with acne. This serum is extremely light weight and helped reduce my redness from my skin. I would highly recommend to others!

extraits.titre: So many benefits in one serum
extraits.texte: After cleansing and toning my skin, I apply my 7 Rice Ceramide Hydrating Barrier Serum twice a day. This has been a great time-saver for me since I used to use Niacinamide followed by Hyaluronic Acid serum twice daily. With this serum combining these two ingredients along with many others, it not only saves time but also helps repair my skin. I use two pumps for my entire face and apply it in small circular motions to ensure it penetrates and absorbs well. I found that the serum has a thicker consistency than I expected, allowing me to really work it into my skin before it dries. After use, my skin is left glowing. Initially, I was worried that the thicker consistency would leave a sticky residue, but it turned out to be the opposite. Once dried, my skin remained hydrated and radiant. This product did not irritate my skin—in fact, it soothed it and reduced any redness I had. As someone with combination skin that leans dry, I was concerned that such hydration might lead to blemishes. However, I haven't experienced any breakouts at all. My skin not only looks glowing but also extremely healthy and well-hydrated. Following the serum, I also apply my moisturizers and eye creams. I've read numerous times about the importance of using SPF daily in the morning. I know this is essential regardless of my skincare routine, and while I sometimes forget, I've been making a conscious effort to ensure I don't skip this step anymore.
